title: Font embedding control — 'Embed…' dialog, character-range model, SWF glyph subsetting
description: Flash 8 text Properties-panel parity. The 'Embed…' button opens the Character Embedding dialog where the user chooses which glyph ranges to embed (All, Uppercase, Lowercase, Numerals, Punctuation, specific characters). Today embedding is implicit (a font is embedded whole when a fontCharId is provided) with no UI control or per-field range selection. Add: (1) model for embedded character ranges per font/field. (2) the 'Embed…' dialog UI in PropertiesPanel. (3) SWF compile: subset DefineFont2/3 glyphs to the chosen ranges (smaller output; currently we embed everything — contributes to the golden 2.7x size gap). Acceptance: choosing 'Numerals only' embeds just 0-9 glyphs and the published SWF font contains only those glyphs.
